messages.text:
According to Harlo L.: What is the typical and maximum power draw in watts, measured at the wall? If the miner has multiple operating modes, could you share the power draw and hash rate for each mode?
Which ASIC chip does the Harlo L. use?

I can't find a Harlo L. anywhere in our catalog, so I don't have its power figures, modes or chip. I won't guess at specs.

Did you mean one of the Harlo miners we do list? Here are the wall figures for the Harlo B30, the one on your order:

Turbo: 30 TH/s at 485 W
Balanced: 24 TH/s at 350 W
ECO: 18 TH/s at 230 W

It uses BM1373 chips. Its maximum draw is 485 W, in Turbo.

If the Loto is a different model, tell me where you saw it and I'll get its specs.

We haven't published wall power, operating modes or the ASIC chip yet. I won't give you numbers until they're confirmed.
